title: EPILOGUE // RED TIDES
narrative: The Iron Fleet sweeps through the Arbor and the Reach like a scythe through wheat. The ancient vineyards are razed, and Oldtown's Hightower burns as a signal fire for the new iron empire. Euron Greyjoy crowns himself with driftwood and drowned gold.
